name: Tilda Brasswick
title: Ley-wright

nodes.speaker: npc
nodes.text: Mind the bench, that crystal's still humming. Tilda Brasswick, ley-wright. I keep the city lit.

nodes.speaker: npc
nodes.text: Every lamp, pump and clock in Tricode drinks from the ley lines under our feet. Three of them cross right beneath the Cathedral. That's the whole reason the city's here.

nodes.speaker: npc
nodes.text: The Sisters call it the Benefactor's gift. I call it a very old, very large power line. Both of us are probably right.

chatter: Who keeps unscrewing the lamp on Brass Lane?
Blue means good. Bright blue means stand back.
The clock's four minutes fast again. Or the sun's slow.
